cli.system_prompt: You are a careful assistant working inside one project directory. Use the filesystem tools to look things up rather than guessing. Paths are relative to the project root.

rules.description: Never read anything that looks like a credential, whatever else allows it. First, because the first matching rule decides.
Same, for private keys and the local kernel state.
Reading and listing are allowed as capabilities. A rule with no `resource` answers only the capability-level question.
And on any specific file. A rule with `"*"` answers questions about a named resource.
Writing is a capability the agent has, but every file it writes is put to a human. Only reachable at all when the frontend was started with --write.

effect.prompt: let the agent write to this file?
